historical_discrepancy_reconciliation.root_cause_of_11_83_discrepancy: The 11.83% estimate in Stage 3B-R arose from a truncated 1-lag approximation: gamma0 + 2(1-1/2)*rho*gamma0 = sigma^2(1+rho) with effective sample size 20.91. When all N-1 lags are summed with the exact finite-sample weights (1-k/N), the exact factor is 1.479167 (N_eff = 20.2817), yielding exactly 11.6141% power.
historical_discrepancy_reconciliation.audit_conclusion: The infinite-sample asymptotic formula slightly underestimates power by 0.06% (11.55% vs 11.61%) because it assumes an infinite sequence of positive auto-covariances, whereas the finite sample truncates at lag N-1 and applies downward-sloping weights (1-k/N). Both 11.55% and 11.61% confirm the trial is deeply underpowered at N=30.
